allowed_interpretation: A donor-bounded calibration of defined RNA readouts against a specific physiological measure in replicative culture aging.
before_outcomes: Freeze an externally justified RNA feature set, source version, direction and arithmetic before relating its values to function. Do not select genes by their observed correlation in this dataset.
Preserve all 22 eligible records and the one missing-function exclusion; do not fill it from adjacent timepoints.
Keep donors separate, retain culture time and passage explicitly, and define the treatment of time-trend confounding before interpretation.
Use original source expression and function values; no new clock training, age imputation or normalization.

inputs.RNA: Pinned GSE179848 investigator-processed log2 VST expression matrix
inputs.function: Source-reported oxidative spare respiratory capacity; pmol O2/min/20,000 cells; source summaries

not_admitted: A biological-age clock result for these cultures
An intervention benefit or reversal-of-aging test
Safety, transformation risk, lineage preservation, post-withdrawal persistence or clinical efficacy
A replacement for the frozen Gill migration/clock comparison or the Phase 483 supervised external exchange

population_scope.independent_units: Two donors; repeated culture timepoints are longitudinal observations, not independent people.

question: Within the admitted untreated adult-origin fibroblast culture records, how do independently specified RNA readouts relate descriptively to source-reported oxidative spare respiratory capacity as the cultures age?
